title: North Carolina State Capitol

buildingCutout.basis: The identified cross-shaped Capitol footprint and projecting porticoes.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified elevation on the Union Square path outside the east portico.

identities.name: North Carolina State Capitol
identities.address: 1 East Edenton Street, Raleigh, North Carolina

mapIdentity.scope: Mapped permanent walls and paired porticoes, architectural drawings described in the official register, and four exact Qualla originals.

note: The National Register records four columns on each east and west portico, five bays at north and south ends, a hidden low roof, an octagonal base and copper dome with anthemion crown.
